source: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics - High School

units.title: Number and Quantity: The Real Number System (N-RN)
topics: Extend the properties of exponents to rational exponents
Use properties of rational and irrational numbers

units.title: Number and Quantity: Quantities (N-Q)
topics: Reason quantitatively and use units to solve problems

units.title: Number and Quantity: The Complex Number System (N-CN)
topics: Perform arithmetic operations with complex numbers
Represent complex numbers and their operations on the complex plane
Use complex numbers in polynomial identities and equations

units.title: Number and Quantity: Vector and Matrix Quantities (N-VM)
topics: Represent and model with vector quantities
Perform operations on matrices and use matrices in applications

units.title: Algebra: Seeing Structure in Expressions (A-SSE)
topics: Write expressions in equivalent forms to solve problems

units.title: Algebra: Arithmetic with Polynomials and Rational Expressions (A-APR)
topics: Understand the relationship between zeros and factors of polynomials
Use polynomial identities to solve problems

units.title: Algebra: Creating Equations (A-CED)
topics: Create equations that describe numbers or relationships

units.title: Algebra: Reasoning with Equations and Inequalities (A-REI)
topics: Understand solving equations as a process of reasoning and explain the reasoning
Solve equations and inequalities in one variable
Represent and solve equations and inequalities graphically

units.title: Functions: Interpreting Functions (F-IF)
topics: Understand the concept of a function and use function notation
Interpret functions that arise in applications in terms of the context

units.title: Functions: Building Functions (F-BF)
topics: Build a function that models a relationship between two quantities
Build new functions from existing functions

units.title: Functions: Linear, Quadratic, and Exponential Models (F-LE)
topics: Construct and compare linear and exponential models and solve problems
Interpret expressions for functions in terms of the situation they model

units.title: Functions: Trigonometric Functions (F-TF)
topics: Extend the domain of trigonometric functions using the unit circle
Model periodic phenomena with trigonometric functions

units.title: Modeling (no domains listed on the standards page)
Geometry: Congruence (G-CO)
topics: Experiment with transformations in the plane
Understand congruence in terms of rigid motions

units.title: Geometry: Similarity, Right Triangles, and Trigonometry (G-SRT)
topics: Understand similarity in terms of similarity transformations
Define trigonometric ratios and solve problems involving right triangles

units.title: Geometry: Circles (G-C)
topics: Understand and apply theorems about circles
Find arc lengths and areas of sectors of circles

units.title: Geometry: Expressing Geometric Properties with Equations (G-GPE)
topics: Translate between the geometric description and the equation for a conic section
Use coordinates to prove simple geometric theorems algebraically

units.title: Geometry: Geometric Measurement and Dimension (G-GMD)
topics: Explain volume formulas and use them to solve problems
Visualize relationships between two-dimensional and three-dimensional objects

units.title: Geometry: Modeling with Geometry (G-MG)
topics: Apply geometric concepts in modeling situations

units.title: Statistics and Probability: Interpreting Categorical and Quantitative Data (S-ID)
topics: Summarize, represent, and interpret data on a single count or measurement variable
Summarize, represent, and interpret data on two categorical and quantitative variables

units.title: Statistics and Probability: Making Inferences and Justifying Conclusions (S-IC)
topics: Understand and evaluate random processes underlying statistical experiments
Make inferences and justify conclusions from sample surveys, experiments and observational studies

units.title: Statistics and Probability: Conditional Probability and the Rules of Probability (S-CP)
topics: Understand independence and conditional probability and use them to interpret data
Use the rules of probability to compute probabilities of compound events in a uniform probability model

units.title: Statistics and Probability: Using Probability to Make Decisions (S-MD)
topics: Calculate expected values and use them to solve problems
Use probability to evaluate outcomes of decisions
